author: Subscriptor
body:
that is completely wrong. i see no reason for that infraction whatsoever. 
there was a guy ingame saying iron ez pop and me iron and zeus were in ts and we laughed about it. 
then i said everybody say "#ironezpop" and only one guy ingame said that too.
then iron said if youre gonna say that one more time youll be punished.
i said that one more time as a joke and he kicked me the guy who said that and zeus for "being disrespectful".
im sorry but there is nothing offensive or disrespectful for saying "ez pop" as he was laughing about it and calling me a faggot after i said ill report him.
this is really sad and im asking to appeal that infractions since it has no meaning, false, and the completely pointless threat of something that isnt breaking the rules and saying "if you say that one more time youull get  kicked" and laughing right after. get serious staff that handle situations properly and can tell players in a serious way if what they are doing is incorrect or breaking the rules which in this situation is completely false.

please remove this infraction. i really hate gaining false infractions.

title: infraction appeal

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello Bootey,

I was talking to iron and we managed to clarify. You were warned more then twice and you still did decide to disobey iron and go ahead and do it. Regardless of wether it was offensive what you said you did fail to follow the directions given by any Avicus staff member. Therefore this appeal is denied. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
